users.roleHelp: Role and municipality are stored in app_metadata (not user-editable). They apply on the next session refresh (≤ 1 h) or sign-in.
users.secretTitle: Account management needs the Supabase secret key
users.secretBody: Creating, deleting and changing accounts uses the Admin API, which requires the secret key (sb_secret_…). It lives only on the server, never in the browser.
users.secretSteps: Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API Keys → Secret keys → create or copy a key; add SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY=sb_secret_… to src/Web/frontend/.env.local and restart the server.

architecture.title: AI pipeline architecture
architecture.subtitle: How the 311 GeoTIFF tiles become Marcaj annotations, the route, measurements and this map — interactive diagrams built from the code in src/AI.
architecture.note: Diagrams made with archify; diagram text is in Romanian. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, click a node for details.

sistem.title: System, end to end
sistem.caption: Organiser data flows through the vineyard pipeline on the laptop into CVAT ZIPs for Marcaj; the corrected export returns to the post chain that produces the route, measurements and this app's data.

perceptie.title: Per-tile perception
perceptie.caption: The stages run on every tile: vegetation mask, row detection, cross-tile linking and blocks, canopies, inter-rows, attributes, waste and AnnSet assembly.

randuri.title: How rows are found
randuri.caption: Dominant angle, row spacing, the filters that tell vines from orchards, and the neighbour-guided pass that recovers missed young vineyards.

deseuri.title: Waste chain
deseuri.caption: Colour candidates, tube and stake filters, a CLIP probe trained on UAVVaste and SAM 3 verification; only team-approved boxes reach the annotations.

traseu.title: Route and measurements
traseu.caption: After Marcaj: walkable domain, must and optional targets, GTSP with OR-Tools, validation (≤ 1.5 % outside, closure at START) and measurements.
